research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Artificial intelligence systems for generation of human body part measurements and human body fit information describe generating body measurements from user data to build body realistic avatars and infer fit characteristics. Methods and systems for user environment customization based on non fungible body data extend these measurements to personalized digital environments. Together, these efforts show research into AI driven body measurement, fit prediction, and user specific virtual experiences.

overview_description.description:
Bold Metrics is building a sustainable future by reducing product returns and informing better design practices. The leading fit technology company headquartered in San Francisco, Bold Metrics uses A. I and machine learning technologies to empower apparel brands to reduce returns, boost conversions, and improve sustainability. Their SaaS solutions provide a simple, scalable way for brands to predict customer body measurements accurately while connecting customers to better-fitting clothing and generating powerful, actionable insights to supercharge the supply chain and reduce a brand's environmental footprint.

Used by trusted brands to reduce fit-related returns, from size recommendations that take into consideration a customer's body shape and fit preference, to enterprise-level solutions that optimize manufacturing from design to distribution, our technology improves the customer experience both in-store and online.

identifier.value: Bold Metrics AI Body Data Platform

product.name: Bold Metrics AI Body Data Platform
product.description: A SaaS platform that uses AI, machine learning, and digital twins to derive body measurements and fit insights from limited shopper inputs for apparel sizing, design, and retail operations.

product.name: Smart Size Chart™
product.description: A customer-facing sizing tool that combines shopper digital twins, garment specifications, and fit preferences to recommend the best size for individual apparel products.

product.name: Virtual Sizer™
product.description: An API-based sizing recommendation solution that uses AI body modeling and garment data to identify the appropriate apparel size for shoppers.

product.name: Apparel Insights®
product.description: An analytics solution that uses aggregated shopper body, fit, purchase, and return data to support apparel design, sizing, merchandising, and operational decisions.

product.name: Agentic Sizing Protocol™
product.description: A sizing protocol that supplies personalized apparel fit and size recommendations to AI shopping agents and conversational commerce experiences.

product.name: Virtual Tailor™
product.description: A body-measurement solution for custom clothiers and tailors that generates accurate customer measurements from simple user inputs without a physical measuring process.
